blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Synthetic biparametric MRI (bpMRI) may help alleviate the limited availability of large and representative prostate MRI datasets for deep learning applications. In this work, we present a conditional 3D diffusion framework for anatomy-conditioned synthesis of complete prostate bpMRI from anatomical masks. The framework supports sequential synthesis, in which T2w and diffusion modalities are generated by separately trained models, and joint synthesis, in which all bpMRI modalities are generated simultaneously within a single model. Five configurations were trained using PI-CAI, FastMRI Prostate, and PROSTATEx datasets to investigate different conditioning schemes, target modalities, and synthesis strategies. Evaluation using distribution-based metrics, paired-image similarity, and qualitative assessment demonstrated the feasibility of both synthesis pathways. Joint synthesis achieved competitive distributional fidelity while generating complete bpMRI, whereas direct synthesis of ADC and computed high-b-value DWI outperformed their derivation from synthetic diffusion-weighted images.
blocks.zh: 合成双配体核磁共振(bpMRI)可能有助于缓解用于深层学习应用的大型和代表性前列腺核磁共振数据集的有限可用性. 在这部作品中,我们提出一个有条件的3D扩散框架,用于解剖学条件下从解剖口罩中合成完整的前列腺bpMRI. 该框架支持顺序合成,其中T2w和传播模式由单独训练的模型生成,联合合成,其中所有bpMRI模式在一个单一模型中同时生成. 使用PI-CAI、FastMRI Prostate和PROSTATEx数据集对五个配置进行了培训,以调查不同的配置方案、目标模式和综合战略。 使用基于分配的衡量标准、配对图像相似性以及质量评估进行的评价,证明了两种合成途径的可行性。 联合合成在产生完整的bpMRI的同时实现了竞争性的分布忠实,而直接合成ADC和计算高b值的DWI则比合成扩散加权图像的衍生效果要好。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Prostate cancer is one of the most common malignancies in men, with more than 1.4 million new cases estimated worldwide in 2022 [ 21 ] . Biparametric MRI (bpMRI) is central to the non-invasive assessment of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) within the PI-RADS framework [ 19 ] . A bpMRI examination comprises T2-weighted imaging (T2w) and diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) acquired at multiple b-values. From these acquisitions, quantitative apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps can be derived, while very-high-b-value DWI may be acquired directly or computed from lower-b-value images.
blocks.zh: 前列腺癌是男性最常见的恶性肿瘤之一,估计2022年全球新增病例超过140万[21]. 双亲核磁共振(bpMRI)是在PI-RADS框架内对具有临床意义的前列腺癌(csPCa)进行非侵入性评估的核心[19]. bpMRI检查包括以多个b值获得的T2加权成像(T2w)和扩散加权成像(DWI). 通过这些收购,可以得出定量的表面扩散系数(ADC)地图,而非常高的b值的DWI则可以直接获得或从低b值的图像中计算.

blocks.en: BpMRI is increasingly used in deep learning applications such as lesion detection, segmentation, and csPCa classification [ 7 , 4 , 6 ] . However, model performance and generalization depend on the availability of large and representative annotated datasets [ 3 ] . This limitation has motivated increasing interest in prostate MRI synthesis as a means of augmenting existing datasets with synthetic images that reproduce clinically relevant imaging characteristics for downstream model development.
blocks.zh: BpMRI越来越多地用于深层学习应用,如损伤检测,分化,以及csPCa分类[7,4,6]. 然而,模型性能和概括化取决于大型和有代表性的附加说明数据集的提供情况[3]. 这种限制促使人们日益关注前列腺核磁共振合成,以此作为一种手段,用合成图像来补充现有的数据集,复制临床相关的成像特征,用于下游模型开发。

blocks.en: Early work on prostate MRI synthesis explored the generation of individual MRI modalities and paired diffusion images using 2D diffusion models [ 16 ] . More recently, several studies have extended prostate MRI synthesis to 3D volumes, including anatomy-conditioned T2w generation for segmentation augmentation [ 1 , 8 ] , clinically conditioned T2w synthesis [ 9 ] , and multimodal generation of T2w, high-b-value DWI, and ADC [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 前列腺核磁共振合成的早期工作探索了利用2D扩散模型生成单个核磁共振模式和配对扩散图像[16]. 最近,一些研究将前列腺核磁共振合成扩展至3D卷,包括解剖学条件的T2w生成用于分化增强[1,8],临床条件的T2w合成[9],以及多模式生成T2w,高b值DWI和ADC[10].

blocks.en: Collectively, these studies demonstrate the feasibility of prostate MRI synthesis using diffusion models. However, anatomy-conditioned generation of complete 3D bpMRI from explicit prostate-zone and lesion masks remains largely unexplored. Furthermore, it remains unclear whether the diffusion component of bpMRI should be synthesized at the acquisition level by generating diffusion-weighted images and subsequently deriving ADC and computed high-b-value DWI, or directly at the biomarker level by generating ADC and computed high-b-value DWI themselves.
blocks.zh: 这些研究集体证明了利用扩散模型进行前列腺核磁共振合成的可行性. 然而,从明显的前列腺区和损伤口罩中产生完整的3D bpMRI的解剖条件仍然基本上没有得到探讨。 此外,BpMRI的传播部分是否应通过生成传播加权图像,然后生成ADC和计算高b值的DWI,或在生物标志一级直接生成ADC和计算高b值的DWI,从而在获取层面合成,这一点还不清楚。

blocks.en: To investigate these alternative synthesis strategies, we present a conditional 3D diffusion framework for anatomy-conditioned generation of complete prostate bpMRI from anatomical masks. The framework supports both sequential synthesis, in which T2w and diffusion modalities are generated by separately trained models, and joint synthesis, in which all bpMRI modalities are generated simultaneously within a single model. It further supports both acquired diffusion targets (LBV and HBV) and diffusion-derived targets (ADC and cHBV), enabling the evaluation of alternative routes for complete bpMRI synthesis. The framework builds upon Med-DDPM [ 5 ] and incorporates direct x 0 x_{0} prediction, anisotropy-aware resolution changes, and flexible conditioning and target configurations. Five model configurations were trained using PI-CAI, FastMRI Prostate, and PROSTATEx data to evaluate different conditioning schemes, target modalities, and synthesis strategies for complete bpMRI generation.
blocks.zh: 为了研究这些替代合成策略,我们提出了一个有条件的3D扩散框架,用于从解剖口罩中生成完整的前列腺bpMRI. 该框架既支持顺序合成,其中T2w和传播模式由单独训练的模型生成,也支持联合合成,其中所有bpMRI模式在一个单一模型中同时生成. 它还支持获得的传播目标(LBV和HBV)和传播衍生目标(ADC和cHBV),从而能够评价完整的bpMRI合成的替代路线。 该框架以Med-DDPM [5]为基础,并包含直接x0xXXXX0]预测,异位感知分辨率变化,以及灵活的条件和目标配置. 使用PI-CAI、FastMRI Prostate和PROSTATEx数据培训了5个模型配置,以评价不同的调制方案、目标模式以及完整的bpMRI生成的合成战略。

(a) Architecture of the conditional 3D diffusion model with anisotropy-aware depth regulation. (b) Example of the condition-guided reverse diffusion process for mask-conditioned T2w synthesis. The same formulation supports alternative conditioning and target configurations.
blocks.zh: 图1:解剖条件前列腺bpMRI合成拟议框架概述. (a) 有条件的三维扩散模型的结构,具有异构-感知深度调控。 (b) 带口罩的T2w合成的条件制导反向扩散过程实例。 同一配方支持替代的调制和目标配置.

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 框架概览

blocks.en: The proposed framework is based on a conditional 3D diffusion architecture derived from Med-DDPM [ 5 ] . The framework employs a 3D U-Net denoiser in which the conditioning information c c is concatenated channel-wise with the noisy sample x t x_{t} at each reverse-diffusion step, yielding the input x ~ t = [ x t , c ] \tilde{x}_{t}=[x_{t},c] .
blocks.zh: 拟议框架基于从Med-DDPM[5]衍生出来的有条件的3D扩散架构. 框架使用3D U-Net denoiser,其中条件信息 c 与吵闹的样本 x t x_{t}在每一反向分散步骤上,通过调制,生成输入 x → t = [ x t, c]\tilde{ x}_{t} [x_{t}, c] 。 。 。

blocks.en: The framework introduces three modifications. First, the denoiser directly predicts the clean target volume, x ^ 0 = f θ ​ ( [ x t , c ] , t ) \hat{x}_{0}=f_{\theta}([x_{t},c],t) , instead of the added noise. Preliminary T2w synthesis experiments indicated substantially improved distributional fidelity compared with noise prediction. This formulation was therefore adopted in all experiments.
blocks.zh: 该框架进行了三项修改。 首先,denoiser直接预测干净的目标体积,x ^ 0 = f → ([x t, c], t]\hat{××0}=f_{\x_{\theta}([x_{t}, c], t),而不是添加的噪音. 初步的T2w合成实验表明,与噪声预测相比,分布的忠诚度大为改善。 因此,所有实验都采用了这一提法。

blocks.en: Second, anisotropy-aware depth regulation (Fig. 1 a) limits through-plane downsampling when the axial depth reaches a predefined minimum, preventing excessive compression of the comparatively low-resolution prostate MRI axis. The decoder mirrors this strategy during upsampling.
blocks.zh: 第二,轴深达到预定最小值时,无异构-感知深度调控(图1a)通过平面下取样限制,防止相对低分辨率前列腺核磁共振轴线的过度压缩. 解码器在上取样时会镜像这个策略.

blocks.en: Third, the conditioning and output configurations extend beyond the original mask-conditioned formulation. The condition c c may consist of the anatomical mask alone (Fig. 1 b) or of the mask concatenated with a T2w volume, while the target x 0 x_{0} may contain either a single modality or multiple modalities. These configurations enable both sequential synthesis, in which T2w and diffusion targets are generated by separately trained models, and joint synthesis, in which all bpMRI modalities are generated simultaneously within a single model.
blocks.zh: 第三,调制和输出配置超出了原有的口罩条件配方. 条件c c 可能由解剖面罩单独组成(图1b)或由T2w体积缩合的面罩组成,而目标x0×××××××××}可能包含单一模式或多种模式. 这些构型既可以进行顺序合成,其中T2w和传播目标由经过单独训练的模型生成,也可以进行联合合成,其中所有bpMRI模式都是在一个模型内同时生成的.

blocks.en: 2.2 Datasets and Image Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集和图像预处理

blocks.en: Three public datasets were used: PI-CAI [ 17 ] , comprising 1,500 bpMRI studies with T2w, ADC, and computed high-b-value DWI (cHBV); PROSTATEx [ 14 ] , comprising 346 mpMRI studies; and FastMRI Prostate [ 18 ] , comprising 312 bpMRI studies. PI-CAI provides prostate-zone and lesion annotations, while corresponding prostate and lesion masks were obtained for FastMRI and PROSTATEx. T2w, ADC, and cHBV were used from PI-CAI, whereas T2w, LBV, and HBV were used from FastMRI and PROSTATEx. FastMRI and PROSTATEx were preprocessed using QP-Prostate [ 15 ] , including image registration and quality control, yielding 235 and 281 usable studies, respectively. For PI-CAI, ADC and cHBV were registered to T2w using Elastix [ 12 ] , resulting in 1,158 usable studies. All volumes were resampled to 0.5 × 0.5 × 3.0 0.5\times 0.5\times 3.0 mm, prostate-centred cropped to 192 × 192 × 20 192\times 192\times 20 voxels, and intensity-normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] .
blocks.zh: 使用了三个公共数据集:PI-CAI [17],包括1,500 bpMRI研究与T2w, ADC,并计算出高b值的DWI(cHBV);PROSTATEx [14],包括346 mpMRI研究;以及FastMRI Prostate [18],包括312 bpMRI研究。 PI-CAI提供前列腺区和损伤说明,同时为FastMRI和PROSTATEx获得相应的前列腺和损伤口罩. T2w、ADC和cHBV是从PI-CAI中使用的,而T2w、LBV和HBV是从FastMRI和PROSTATEx中使用的。 FastMRI和PROSTATEx是使用QP-Prostate [15]进行预处理的,包括图像注册和质量控制,分别产生235和281个可用研究. 就PI-CAI而言,ADC和cHBV使用Elastix [12]注册到T2w,结果进行了1,158项可用研究. 所有卷被重新标注为0.5×0.5×3.0 0.5\时为0.5×3.0毫米,以前列腺为中心的收割量为192×192×20 192×时为20伏牛,强度-正常化为[−1,1][-1,1].

blocks.en: 2.3 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 2.3 实验设计

blocks.en: In prostate bpMRI, DWI is acquired at multiple diffusion weightings, or b b -values, typically including a low- b b -value image (LBV, approximately 50 50 – 100 ​ s / mm 2 100~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}} ) and a high- b b -value image (HBV, approximately 800 800 – 1000 ​ s / mm 2 1000~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}} ). These acquisitions can be used to derive additional diffusion representations, including apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps and computed high- b b -value DWI (cHBV, approximately 1400 ​ s / mm 2 1400~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}} ). This motivates two alternative diffusion synthesis strategies: generation of the acquired diffusion images (LBV and HBV), from which ADC and cHBV can subsequently be derived, and direct generation of the diffusion-derived representations ADC and cHBV.
blocks.zh: 在前列腺bpMRI中,DWI是在多重扩散权重,或bb-值时获得的,一般包括一个低-bb-值图像(LBV,约50–100 s / mm 2 100~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}}})和一个高-b-值图像(HBV,约800–1000 s /mm 2 1000~\mathrm{s/mm^{2}}). 这些获取可用于得出额外的扩散表示,包括表面扩散系数图和计算出高b b - 值的DWI(cHBV,约1400 s /mm 2,1400 mathrm{s/mm^{2}}). 这激励了两种替代性的传播合成策略:生成获得的传播图像(LBV和HBV),从中可以得出ADC和cHBV,直接生成传播衍生的表示ADC和cHBV.

blocks.en: Each diffusion target configuration was evaluated using both synthesis strategies supported by the proposed framework: sequential synthesis and joint synthesis. In sequential synthesis, a dedicated mask-conditioned model first generates T2w. A second model, conditioned on both the anatomical mask and the T2w volume, then generates either LBV/HBV or ADC/cHBV. During complete bpMRI synthesis, the generated T2w volume is used to condition the second-stage model. In joint synthesis, a single mask-conditioned model generates T2w together with either LBV/HBV or ADC/cHBV. The resulting experimental design comprises five model configurations, summarized in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 利用拟议框架支持的两种综合战略,即顺序合成和联合合成,评价了每一种传播目标配置。 在顺序合成中,一个专用的口罩条件模型首先生成T2w. 第二个模型以解剖面具和T2w体积为条件,然后生成LBV/HBV或ADC/cHBV. 在完整的bpMRI合成过程中,用生成的T2w体积来条件二级模型. 在联合合成中,一个单一的面具条件模型与LBV/HBV或ADC/cHBV一起生成T2w. 由此产生的实验设计包括5个模型配置,摘要见表1。

blocks.en: M1 was trained using PI-CAI and FastMRI (1615/120 train/test cases), M2 and M4 using PROSTATEx and FastMRI (476/40), and M3 and M5 using PI-CAI only (1146/12), according to the availability of the target modalities.
blocks.zh: M1使用PI-CAI和FastMRI(1615/120列车/测试案例)进行训练,M2和M4使用PROSTATEx和FastMRI(476/40),M3和M5只使用PI-CAI(1146/12),根据目标模式的可用性.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Experimental configurations for sequential and joint prostate bpMRI synthesis. M1–M5 denote the five trained model configurations. In sequential synthesis, models are listed in their order of application.
blocks.zh: 表1 相继和联合前列腺bpMRI合成的实验配置. M1–M5表示五个训练有素的模型配置. 在顺序合成中,模型按其应用顺序列出.

blocks.en: 2.4 Training Details
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训详情

blocks.en:
All models were trained using Adam, scale-shift normalization, 250 diffusion steps, and the direct x 0 x_{0} -prediction objective. M1 and M2 used 64 initial U-Net channels (166.8M parameters), whereas M3–M5 used 96 channels (375.2M parameters). Learning rates were set to 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} for M1, M4, and M5 and to 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for M2 and M3. All remaining optimization settings followed Med-DDPM [ 5 ] .
To soften sharp boundaries in the anatomical condition, anisotropic Gaussian smoothing ( σ z = 0.4 \sigma_{z}=0.4 , σ x ​ y = 1.0 \sigma_{xy}=1.0 ) was applied stochastically to conditioning masks during training, with probabilities of 40% for M1 and 50% for M2–M5.
Training minimized a voxel-wise L 1 L_{1} loss. For multi-target models, modality-specific losses were combined using empirically selected weights to balance learning across modalities.
blocks.zh:
所有模型都使用亚当, 规模转变的正常化, 250扩散步骤, 和直接x0xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx M1和M2使用了64个初始U-Net信道(166.8M参数),而M3–M5则使用了96个信道(375.2M参数). M1、M4、M5的学习率定为2×10 − 5 2\Times 10\Times 5}M2和M3的学习率定为1×10~5 1\Times 10\Times 10\Times 5}。 所有剩余的优化设置都遵循了Med-DDPM [5].
为软化解剖条件的尖锐边界,Aisotropic Gaussian平滑(σ=0.4\sigma_{z}=0.4,σ=1.0\sigma_{xy1.0)在训练时被按曲谱应用来调节口罩,M1的概率为40%,M2–M5的概率为50%.
训练将输液减到最低 对于多目标模型,采用经验性选择的权重将特定模式的损失合并起来,以平衡不同模式的学习。

blocks.en: 2.5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.5 评价

blocks.en: Distribution-based evaluation:
blocks.zh: 基于分配的评价:

blocks.en:
The alignment between the real and synthetic image distributions was evaluated using FID [ 11 ] , KID [ 2 ] , and Precision and Recall [ 13 ] . Metrics were computed on the 20 axial slices of each volume, treated as independent samples. The synthetic volumes used for this evaluation were generated from an augmented set of PI-CAI anatomical masks. Augmentation was designed to increase anatomical variability and balance lesion-positive and lesion-negative cases, and included prostate-level transformations (flipping and scaling) as well as lesion-level transformations (flipping, translation, and transfer between anatomically similar prostates). The resulting set comprised 1,500 masks. Synthetic volumes were generated using the corresponding sequential and joint synthesis pipelines. In sequential synthesis, T2w volumes were first generated from the augmented masks and subsequently used, together with the masks, to generate LBV/HBV or ADC/cHBV. In joint synthesis, all target modalities were generated directly from the augmented masks.
For each modality, synthetic volumes were compared with a size-matched real reference set: 1,500 real and synthetic PI-CAI T2w volumes, 1,158 real and synthetic PI-CAI ADC and cHBV volumes, and 516 real and synthetic FastMRI/PROSTATEx LBV and HBV volumes.
blocks.zh:
通过FID[11],KID[2],以及精度和回顾[13],对真实图像和合成图像分布之间的校正进行了评价。 每卷20个轴切片的量子被计算出来,作为独立的样品处理。 用于这一评价的合成量来自一套扩大的PI-CAI解剖口罩。 增强功能旨在增加解剖变异性,平衡损伤阳性和损伤阴性病例,包括前列腺一级转化(裂解和缩放)以及损伤一级转化(裂解、翻译和在解剖类似前列腺之间的转移)。 由此产生的一套包括1 500个口罩。 利用相应的顺序和联合合成管道生成合成量。 在顺序合成中,T2w卷首先由增强口罩产生,随后与口罩一起用于生成LBV/HBV或ADC/cHBV. 在联合综合中,所有目标模式都直接来自增强口罩。
对于每种方式,合成卷与大小匹配的实际参考集进行了比较:1,500个真实和合成的PI-CAI T2w卷,1,158个真实和合成的PI-CAI ADC和cHBV卷,516个真实和合成的FastMRI/PROSTATEx LBV和HBV卷.

blocks.en: Paired-image evaluation:
blocks.zh: Paired-image评价:

blocks.en:
PSNR and SSIM [ 20 ] were computed volume-wise between each generated volume and its matched real target for all test cases. Metrics were computed within the prostate region and averaged across datasets when applicable.
For models conditioned only on anatomical masks (M1, M4, and M5), these metrics should be interpreted as measures of case-specific anatomical consistency rather than reconstruction fidelity.
blocks.zh:
PSNR和SSIM [20]是在每个生成的体积与其所有试验案例的对应实际目标之间按体积计算的。 在前列腺区域内计算了计量,并在适用的情况下对数据集进行平均计算。
对于仅以解剖口罩(M1、M4和M5)为条件的模型,这些计量标准应解释为针对具体病例的解剖一致性,而不是重建忠贞度。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: For T2w synthesis (Table 2 ), the joint models M4 and M5 achieved distribution-based performance comparable to that of the dedicated T2w model M1. M1 obtained the lowest FID and KID values, while both M4 and M5 achieved higher Precision and Recall. These results indicate that jointly generating T2w together with additional diffusion modalities does not substantially compromise the realism or diversity of the synthesized T2w images.
blocks.zh: 对于T2w合成(表2),联合型号M4和M5实现了可与专用T2w型号M1. M1相比的分布式性能,M1获得了最低的FID和KID值,而M4和M5都实现了更高的精度和召回. 这些结果表明,联合生成T2w和额外的扩散方式不会大大损害合成的T2w图像的现实主义或多样性.

blocks.en: The qualitative examples in Fig. 2 illustrate differences in the generated T2w appearances. M1 generally produced sharper anatomical boundaries and more detailed T2w texture, whereas the jointly generated T2w images from M4 and M5 appeared slightly smoother while remaining anatomically consistent with the conditioning masks.
blocks.zh: 图2中的定性例子说明了生成的T2w外观的差异. M1一般产生更尖锐的解剖边界和更详细的T2w纹理,而联合生成的M4和M5的T2w图像则显得略为平滑,同时在解剖学上仍然与调节口罩一致.

blocks.en: The paired-image evaluation also favoured M4 (PSNR/SSIM: 20.19/0.30), followed by M1 (18.84/0.26) and M5 (18.69/0.23). Since all models were conditioned exclusively on anatomical masks, these metrics should be interpreted as measures of case-specific anatomical consistency rather than reconstruction fidelity. Overall, the results suggest that joint synthesis can generate realistic T2w images while preserving comparable case-specific agreement to a dedicated T2w model.
blocks.zh: 配对图像评价也有利于M4(PSNR/SSIM:20.19/0.30),其次是M1(18.84/0.26)和M5(18.69/0.23)。 由于所有模型都完全以解剖口罩为条件,这些计量标准应被解释为针对具体案例的解剖一致性的衡量标准,而不是重建忠诚度的衡量标准。 总体而言,这些结果表明,联合合成可以产生现实的T2w图像,同时保留与专用T2w模型可比较的个案特定协议.

blocks.zh: 图2:M1、M4和M5两个增强口罩的代表T2w合成实例。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Distribution-based metrics for diffusion modality synthesis. For ADC and cHBV, the column “M4-derived” corresponds to modalities computed from synthetic LBV and HBV generated by M4.
blocks.zh: 表3:用于传播方式综合的基于分配的衡量尺度。 对于ADC和cHBV,“M4-衍生”栏对应的是从合成LBV和M4生成的HBV中计算出来的模式.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Representative LBV/HBV synthesis examples from the sequential model M2 (left) and the joint model M4 (right).
blocks.zh: 图3 代表LBV/HBV合成实例 从顺序模型M2(左)和联合模型M4(右).

blocks.en:
For LBV and HBV synthesis (Table 3 ),
the joint model M4 achieved better distribution-based performance
than the sequential model M2, with consistently lower FID and KID
values and higher Precision, while Recall was higher for LBV and
slightly lower for HBV. These results indicate that jointly
generating T2w, LBV, and HBV can reproduce the distribution and
variability of real diffusion-weighted images without degrading
image realism.

值和更高的精度,而LBV和LBV的召回率较高

blocks.en: The paired-image evaluation favoured M2, which achieved higher LBV SSIM (0.72 vs. 0.63) and higher HBV PSNR/SSIM (17.11/0.57 vs. 15.74/0.53), while M4 obtained a slightly higher LBV PSNR (20.41 vs. 20.14). This difference is consistent with the additional real T2w conditioning available to M2. Overall, joint synthesis better matched the real image distribution, whereas sequential synthesis preserved stronger case-specific correspondence.
blocks.zh: 配对图像评价偏向M2,实现了更高的LBV SSIM(0.72对0.63)和更高的HBV PSNR/SSIM(17.11/0.57对15.74/0.53),而M4则获得了略高的LBV PSNR(20.41对20.14). 这种差异与M2可用的额外真实的T2w调制一致. 总体而言,联合合成更符合真实的图像分布,而顺序合成则保留了较强的个案对应.

blocks.en: The examples in Fig. 3 show that both models reproduced the expected contrast differences between LBV and HBV while preserving prostate morphology. In some cases, M2 produced lesion regions with sharper, mask-conforming boundaries than those observed in real DWI, suggesting a degree of mask imprinting. This observation is qualitative and was not assessed by experts.
blocks.zh: 图3中的例子显示,这两个模型都重复了LBV和HBV的预期对比差异,同时保留了前列腺形态. 在某些情况下,M2产生的损伤区比在真正的DWI中观察到的更尖锐,面罩一致的界限,表明有一定程度的面具印记. 这一意见是定性的,没有经过专家评估。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Representative ADC/cHBV synthesis examples from the sequential model M3 (left) and the joint model M5 (right).
blocks.zh: 图4:代表式ADC/cHBV合成实例来自顺序模型M3(左)和联合模型M5(右).

blocks.en: For ADC and cHBV synthesis (Table 3 ), the sequential model M3 and the joint model M5 achieved very similar distribution-based performance. ADC metrics were nearly identical, while M3 showed a slight advantage for cHBV, achieving lower FID and KID values and higher Recall. These results indicate that jointly generating T2w, ADC, and cHBV does not substantially compromise the quality of the diffusion-derived modalities.
blocks.zh: 对于ADC和cHBV合成(表3),顺序模型M3和联合模型M5实现了非常相似的基于分布的性能. ADC的度量衡几乎完全相同,而M3对cHBV表现出微弱的优势,实现了较低的FID值和KID值以及更高的召回值. 这些结果表明,联合生成T2w、ADC和cHBV不会大大损害传播方式的质量。

blocks.en:
A clearer difference emerged when comparing direct synthesis with
the acquired-DWI pathway. ADC and cHBV computed from synthetic LBV
and HBV generated by M4 showed substantially worse distribution-based
performance than the directly synthesized modalities produced by
M3 and M5. This degradation was observed across all metrics except
cHBV Precision, which was slightly higher for the derived images,
suggesting that errors introduced during LBV and HBV synthesis
propagate to the derived ADC and cHBV representations.

blocks.en: The paired-image evaluation also favoured M3, which achieved higher PSNR/ SSIM values for both ADC (20.34/0.59 vs. 19.78/0.52) and cHBV (16.01/0.38 vs. 14.60/0.35). As in the LBV/HBV experiments, this advantage should be interpreted in light of the additional real T2w conditioning available to M3.
blocks.zh: 配对图像评价也有利于M3,它使ADC(20.34/0.59对19.78/052)和cHBV(16.01/0.38对14.60/0.35)的PSNR/SSIM值都提高了。 与LBV/HBV实验一样,这一优势应当根据M3可用的额外真实T2w调节来解释.

blocks.en: The examples in Fig. 4 show that both models reproduced the expected diffusion contrast patterns and lesion-associated signal changes while preserving consistency with the conditioning anatomy.
blocks.zh: 图4中的例子显示,这两个模型都复制了预期的传播对比模式和与损伤相关的信号变化,同时保持了与条件解剖学的一致性.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Comparison of derived (left) and directly generated (right) ADC and cHBV. The lesion is highlighted by the red circle.
blocks.zh: 图5:衍生(左)和直接生成(右)ADC和cHBV的比较. 损伤以红圈突出.

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates the two investigated routes for obtaining ADC and cHBV: derivation from synthetic LBV/HBV and direct synthesis. Consistent with the quantitative results, the directly generated modalities exhibit patterns that more closely resemble those of the real data, whereas artefacts introduced during LBV and HBV synthesis may propagate to the derived ADC and cHBV images.
blocks.zh: 图5说明了获得ADC和cHBV的两个被调查路线:从合成LBV/HBV和直接合成得到的. 与定量结果一致的是,直接生成的模式显示出更接近真实数据的模式,而LBV和HBV合成过程中引进的工艺品则可能传播到衍生的ADC和cHBV图像中。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
This study presented a conditional 3D DDPM framework for anatomy-conditioned synthesis of prostate bpMRI, supporting both sequential and joint generation of T2w and diffusion modalities from anatomical masks. The results demonstrate the feasibility of both synthesis strategies. Joint synthesis showed modality-specific differences in distributional
fidelity relative to dedicated models while generating complete bpMRI
examinations within a single model. For diffusion-derived modalities, direct synthesis of ADC and cHBV consistently achieved better distribution-based performance than derivation from synthetic LBV and HBV, suggesting that errors introduced during diffusion-image synthesis may propagate to the derived representations.
blocks.zh:
这项研究为前列腺bpMRI的解剖条件合成提供了有条件的3D DDPM框架,支持从解剖口罩中连续和联合生成T2w和传播模式. 结果表明,这两项综合战略都是可行的。 联合综合显示分配方式上的具体差异
相对于专用模型的忠诚度,同时生成完整的 bpMRI
在单一模式内进行考试。 就扩散衍生模式而言,直接合成ADC和cHBV比合成LBV和HBV的生成更能持续地实现基于分配的性能,这表明扩散-图像合成过程中引入的错误可能会传播到衍生的表达中。

blocks.en: Although the quantitative evaluation and qualitative examples support the plausibility of the generated images, further validation is required to determine whether diagnostically relevant characteristics are preserved and whether the generated data provide clinical value. Future work will therefore include expert radiological assessment and evaluation in downstream tasks such as csPCa classification, lesion detection, and prostate segmentation.
blocks.zh: 虽然定量评价和定性实例支持生成的图像的可信度,但还需要进一步验证以确定诊断相关特征是否保留,生成的数据是否提供临床价值. 因此,今后的工作将包括对下游任务(如CsPCa分类、损伤检测和前列腺分解)进行放射性专家评估和评价。
